card.name: Drug interaction advice wording
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation inside drug-interaction sentences about CYP enzymes or co-medications such as warfarin, just before the advice or reason clause (should be monitored, as co-administration may...).

modes.label: Before monitoring advice
modes.description: The word 'should' after a named drug or drug class, leading into monitoring or caution.
modes.example: patients receiving warfarin therapy<< should>> be carefully monitored when duloxetine delayed-release

modes.label: Inside CYP enzyme names
modes.description: Partway through CYP names such as CYP3A, on the letter or digit.
modes.example: refer to the Prescribing Information for the CYP<<3>>A substrates for dosing instructions.

modes.label: Linking punctuation and phrases
modes.description: A comma, colon or 'such' that introduces a reason, formula or example list.
modes.example: antifungals<< such>> as terbinafine and medications for
